passives.name: Nirvana's Inferno
passives.description: When an ally is hit, counterattacks with Nirvana's Inferno. (Triggered Effect) Before attacking, removes [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_2_1] buff(s) from the target, and inflicts reduced Resilience for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_2_4_1] turn(s). If the target is Earth element, ignores the target's Resilience, and does not miss.

buffs.summary: −100% BUFF_RESIST if attacker has element advantage
−100% BUFF_RESIST if attacker has element disadvantage
−100% BUFF_RESIST if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage

passives.name: Cute Kitten in Training
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). At the start of the turn, increases Attack of the caster by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_common_atkup], and if Kuro is alive, grants a Barrier to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000080_4_1] turn(s). When Kuro is revived, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000079_2_5].
